provenance.paper_title: VideoLLaMB: Long Video Understanding with Recurrent Memory Bridges

evidence.section: Full paper: 2.3. Memory Cache with Retrieval
evidence.paraphrase: Recurrent memory tokens bridge SceneTilling segments and carry latent context forward.

evidence.section: Full paper: 2.2. Recurrent Memory Bridge Layers
evidence.paraphrase: A learned recurrent bridge updates persistent memory tokens between semantic scenes. For VideoLLaMB, this specifically supports a trained but frozen update module of recurrent bridge memory tokens.

adjudication_notes: Strict-tier full-paper review (PDF p. 2): During inference, the operative memory component (recurrent bridge memory tokens) changes through a trained but frozen update module; the governing policy remains fixed, and any learning reported by the paper occurs before deployment. Training-time learning, when present, was not counted as T3.
